details.description:
Discover the secret to strong, healthy, and long hair with
Clinic Plus Strong & Long Shampoo. Infused with the nourishing power of
milk proteins and multivitamins, this shampoo is designed to strengthen hair
from root to tip, promoting natural growth and reducing breakage. Whether
you're looking for a solution to hair fall or simply seeking a reliable shampoo
for everyday use, Clinic Plus delivers visible results with every wash.
This mild yet effective formula is suitable for all hair
types, making it an ideal choice for women and men alike. Acting as a gentle
yet powerful cleanser, it works to restore hair health while maintaining its
natural shine. Unlike harsh alternatives like sulphate and paraben free shampoo
or clarifying shampoo, Clinic Plus provides balanced care that leaves your hair
feeling soft, strong, and nourished.
Say goodbye to common hair concerns with this versatile
shampoo. Whether you're searching for the best shampoo for hair fall control, a
reliable hair fall shampoo for women, or even a mild everyday shampoo, Clinic
Plus has you covered. Its milk protein formula not only strengthens hair but
also helps reduce breakage, ensuring your hair stays long and beautiful.
Empower your hair with Clinic Plus Strong & Long Shampoo
and experience the difference of consistent nourishment. Treat your hair to the
care it deserves and enjoy the confidence that comes with strong, healthy
locks.

Clinic Plus introduces its new Strong & Long Naturals Shampoo. This is a mild shampoo and ideal for daily use. It contains milk protein and herbal extracts for hair that is healthy and shiny. You can use this along with a suitable Clinic Plus conditioner and hair oil for optimum results. Do use this shampoo after oiling your hair to get rid of that greasy, oily feeling as this natural shampoo is going to leave you with hair that's soft and beautiful. This product here is a big-sized bottle that is going to last you quite long.

When a daughter is raised to be strong, she discovers that the confidence to face life's obstacles comes naturally to her. Clinic Plus encourages mothers to empower their girls by giving them foundational strength, as it is the seed from which innate, natural strength grows. A solid foundation is always essential and empowering both in life, and when it comes to hair as well. Hair can only grow when it is given the strength to do so. This is why Clinic Plus shampoos are imbibed with ingredients that nurture each hair shaft and make girls long, growing hair robust. Treat your hair to some of natures finest gifts with the Clinic Plus Shikakai shampoo. Infused with hair-healthy herbs such as shikakai, reetha and amla, it works to condition and strengthen hair. Shikakai, known as hair fruit, is renowned for its hair care and cleansing benefits. Reetha and amla are also packed with nutrients that are known to condition hair, giving it the strength it needs as it grows longer. Experience the power of natural ingredients and get hair that's up to 30 times stronger* as it grows longer with the Clinic Plus Shikakai shampoo. *Strength due to reduced hair breakage, based on lab test vs non-conditioning shampoo.

Reveal healthy, lustrous hair with Clinic Plus Strong & Long Naturals Shampoo. Infused with nourishing milk protein and revitalising herbal extracts, this mild, daily-use formula gently cleanses while strengthening and adding shine to your tresses. For best results, pair the shampoo with a Clinic Plus conditioner and hair oil to achieve optimal nourishment and vitality. Simply apply to wet hair, work into a creamy lather, leave on for a minute, and rinse thoroughly. Unlock the power of nature for hair that is healthy, strong, and radiantly beautiful.

Known for its nourishing properties, the egg protein formula ensures your hair stays smooth, strong, and visibly radiant. Clinic Plus Egg Protein Shampoo works wonders as a reliable hair care companion. It's a great choice for those seeking a gentle, mild shampoo for everyday use. Unlike harsh alternatives, it nurtures your hair while maintaining its natural strength and shine. Ideal for women, men, and even kids, it's a versatile product that meets the needs of every family member.
Say goodbye to hair woes like breakage and dullness with this shampoo that doubles as a mild yet powerful cleanser. It's not just a shampoo; it's a step toward healthier, shinier hair. Whether you're looking for a solution for dandruff, hair fall control, or simply a boost in shine, Clinic Plus Strength & Shine Shampoo is your go-to choice. Clinic Plus believes that girls who have been raised to be
strong become women who face challenges with confidence and determination. A
girl is truly empowered when she is guided by her mother to find her inner
strength, so she can conquer obstacles she encounters in her journey through
life. A solid foundation is always essential and empowering both in life and
when it comes to hair as well. Hair can grow when it is given the strength to
do so, which is why Clinic Plus shampoos are imbued with ingredients that
nourish girls’ hair and help give it strength.
Clinic Plus Strong & Thick Shampoo is infused with the
goodness of rice water, protein, and vitamin E. This powerful duo in Clinic
Plus Strong & Thick Shampoo works towards reducing breakage, nourishing
your hair from within, and helping make hair visibly thick with every wash.^
Choose Clinic Plus Rice Water, Protein, and Vitamin E
Shampoo for hair that is thick with every wash. It is suitable for all hair
types and can be used by the whole family. For best results, gently massage on
wet scalp and hair and rinse thoroughly.
^Based on lab test vs uncleaned hair.

Indulge your hair in the luxurious care of Clinic Plus Nourishing Hair Oil, a transformative elixir that goes beyond ordinary hair care routines. This nourishing hair oil is crafted to strengthen and nourish your hair from root to tip with every gentle massage on your scalp. Infused with a harmonious blend of mineral and coconut oils, it provides a special shine and an extra layer of care that your hair deserves. The non-greasy formula ensures you can confidently step out after application without worrying about an oily residue. Massage the oil from root to tip, allowing its rejuvenating properties to work their magic on every strand. Clinic Plus Nourishing Hair Oil also penetrates deep into the hair shaft, providing essential nutrients that enhance hair health for a vibrant, full-of-life appearance. Enjoy the refreshing fragrance as the subtle scent lingers throughout the day. Fortify your hair, reduce breakage, and gift yourself the deep nourishment your tresses crave with Clinic Plus Nourishing Hair Oil.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Massage oil from roots to the hair.
2. Leave at-least for an hour on to the scalp.
3. Rinse with Clinic Plus Shampoo.
details.storageInstructions:
*Store in a cool, dry place
*Protect from direct sunlight
